answer_1.quote: we investigate the performance of current state-of-the-art NLP technology on free-form question answering in the English language domain.
answer_1.outputs: free-form answers to metalinguistic questions about English

answer_2.quote: We saved multiple checkpoints during fine-tuning and evaluated them with the interpolation of BLEU, BERTScore and ROUGE on the dev set to choose the best-performing one

answer_4.quote: Human evaluators were presented with the question title and body, and then asked to rate 5 answers: a top-rated human-provided answer, a low-rated human-provided answer, and answers generated by 3 of our best models
answer_4.guideline: raters were asked to give ratings (via a slider widget, on a 1-5 integer scale—the higher, the better) for two criteria (C1 & C2): 1. Does the answer look grammatically/ structurally like a good answer (ignoring whether it answers the question)? 2. Is the information in this answer a valid response to the question (ignoring formatting/ stylistic issues)?
